sql_model.form_descr: Pre-register or walk-in guests, approve, check in and out

rules.sql: SELECT unit_no FROM CCW_MEMBER_OWNER WHERE LOWER(owner_email) = LOWER(:user_email) UNION SELECT unit_no FROM CCW_TENANT_PROFILE WHERE LOWER(tenant_email) = LOWER(:user_email) AND tenant_status = 'A'

validations.name: Entry type is a listed value
validations.message: Entry type must be P or W.

validations.name: At least 1 person
validations.message: No of persons must be at least 1.

validations.name: ID Proof Type is a listed value
validations.message: ID Proof Type must be one of: A, P, D, S, V, O

validations.name: Unit exists
validations.message: Unit not found in Unit Master.

column.name: person_to_meet
column.heading: Person to Meet
column.descr: Person being visited (defaults to the unit's contact person)

column.name: valid_to_time
column.heading: Valid To
column.descr: Pass valid until (must be after valid from)

column.name: pass_code
column.heading: Pass Code
column.descr: Unique 6-character pass code, generated on save for Pre-Registered entries

column.name: pass_qr
column.heading: Pass QR
column.descr: QR payload (the pass code), generated on save

column.name: status
column.heading: Status
column.descr: Changed by actions; starts Expected (Pre-Registered) or Awaiting Approval (Walk-In)

column.name: list_state
column.heading: Display State
column.descr: Derived: an Expected entry past its date shows as Expired
column.sql_expression: CASE WHEN {CCW_GUEST_ENTRY}.status = 'E' AND {CCW_GUEST_ENTRY}.expected_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'Expired' ELSE NULL END

column.name: approved_via
column.heading: Approved Via
column.descr: App or Phone (set by Approve actions)

column.name: approved_by
column.heading: Approved By
column.descr: Resident (or phone approver name) who approved/rejected

column.name: checked_in_by
column.heading: Checked In By
column.descr: Security user who checked the guest in

column.name: check_out_time
column.heading: Check Out Time
column.descr: Set by Check Out (after check in)

column.name: security_remark
column.heading: Security Remark
column.descr: Required for a check-in outside the valid window or on a different date

edit_lock.reason: Only Expected entries can be edited.

validations.name: Pre-registered date not past
validations.message: Expected date cannot be in the past.

validations.name: Valid to after valid from
validations.message: Valid To time must be after Valid From time.

validations.name: Walk-in ID proof
validations.message: ID proof type and number are mandatory for a Walk-In guest.

validations.name: Walk-in is today
validations.message: A Walk-In guest's expected date is today.

validations.name: Checkout after checkin
validations.message: Check out time must be after check in time.

validations.name: Expected only
validations.message: Only Expected entries can be deleted.

business_logic.spec: Allowed only when STATUS='W' (Awaiting Approval). The signed-in user's email must match CCW_MEMBER_OWNER.OWNER_EMAIL for the entry's UNIT_NO, or CCW_TENANT_PROFILE.TENANT_EMAIL for that unit with TENANT_STATUS='A' (case-insensitive); otherwise error 'Only a member or active tenant of this unit can approve'. Set STATUS='A', APPROVED_VIA='A' (App), APPROVED_BY = the user's name/email. Notify the security desk / unit contacts. Return {"message":"Guest approved"}.

validations.name: Awaiting approval
validations.message: Only entries Awaiting Approval can be approved.

capture.prompt: Name of the resident who approved by phone

business_logic.spec: For security/management users only. Allowed only when STATUS='W'. Require a non-blank APPROVED_BY (the name of the person who approved) from the payload. Set STATUS='A', APPROVED_VIA='P' (Phone), APPROVED_BY from the payload. Return {"message":"Approval recorded by phone"}.

validations.name: Awaiting approval
validations.message: Only entries Awaiting Approval can be approved.

business_logic.spec: Allowed only when STATUS='W' and only for a member (CCW_MEMBER_OWNER.OWNER_EMAIL) or active tenant (CCW_TENANT_PROFILE.TENANT_EMAIL, TENANT_STATUS='A') of the entry's UNIT_NO, matched to the signed-in user's email (case-insensitive). Set STATUS='J' (Rejected), APPROVED_VIA='A', APPROVED_BY = the user. The record is then locked. Return {"message":"Guest rejected"}.

validations.name: Awaiting approval
validations.message: Only entries Awaiting Approval can be rejected.

capture.prompt: Security remark (mandatory if outside the valid time window or on a different date)

business_logic.spec: Allowed only when STATUS is 'E' (Expected, and EXPECTED_DATE = today) or 'A' (Approved); an Expected entry on a different date, or an entry checked in outside VALID_FROM_TIME..VALID_TO_TIME (when set), requires a non-blank SECURITY_REMARK from the payload, else error. Set STATUS='I', CHECK_IN_TIME = now, CHECKED_IN_BY = signed-in user's email, SECURITY_REMARK from the payload when given. Notify the unit contacts (unit owners from CCW_MEMBER_OWNER and the active tenant). Return {"message":"Guest checked in"}.

validations.name: Expected or Approved
validations.message: Only Expected or Approved entries can be checked in.

business_logic.spec: Allowed only when STATUS='I'. Set STATUS='O' and CHECK_OUT_TIME = now (must be after CHECK_IN_TIME). Notify the unit contacts. Return {"message":"Guest checked out"}.

validations.name: Checked in
validations.message: Only Checked In entries can be checked out.

business_logic.spec: Allowed for the registering user, residents of the unit, or security/management, when STATUS is 'E', 'W' or 'A'. Set STATUS='C'; the record is then locked. Return {"message":"Entry cancelled"}.

validations.name: Cancellable
validations.message: Only Expected, Awaiting Approval or Approved entries can be cancelled.

capture.prompt: Scan the guest's pass QR (or type the 6-character code)

business_logic.description: Look up an entry by scanned pass
business_logic.spec: Normalise SCANNED_CODE (trim, upper-case, strip any wrapper such as a URL or KEY=value prefix) and find the CCW_GUEST_ENTRY with that PASS_CODE; error 'Pass not found' otherwise. Return {"message": ...} summarising GUEST_ENTRY_NO, GUEST_NAME, UNIT_NO, purpose, EXPECTED_DATE, valid window and STATUS, plus a warning when the date or time window does not match or the status is not Expected/Approved (already used or cancelled).

business_logic.description: Generate pass code/QR and notify the unit for walk-ins
business_logic.spec: On action='add' only. For ENTRY_TYPE='P' (Pre-Registered): generate a random unique 6-character upper-case alphanumeric PASS_CODE (no ambiguous characters; retry until no CCW_GUEST_ENTRY row has it) and set PASS_QR to the same value (the QR payload) on the header row, STATUS='E'. For ENTRY_TYPE='W' (Walk-In): STATUS='W', EXPECTED_DATE = today, no pass code. Enforce that a Pre-Registered entry's pass is returned to the user in the success message ('Pass code: XXXXXX').

business_logic.description: Ask the unit to approve a Walk-In
business_logic.spec: On action='add' with ENTRY_TYPE='W': create an in-app notification and email to every owner of the entry's UNIT_NO (CCW_MEMBER_OWNER.OWNER_EMAIL with LOGIN_ENABLED='Y') and to the active tenant with login (CCW_TENANT_PROFILE, TENANT_STATUS='A', LOGIN_ENABLED='Y') asking them to Approve or Reject the guest (name, company, purpose, persons). Never blocks the save.
